lines.en: Ben, come meet Jerry's wife.
Gail.
Happy Holidays, Chris.
So good to see you.
I have someone I'd like you to meet.
I'm Gail Gergage.
Gail, you're Gail.
Jerry's beautiful wife.
Who looks like that.
Gail, I hope you're not in any way uncomfortable
that I'm here since I dated your daughter.
Oh, not at all.
You're welcome here at any time.
Oops, there's a little hair on your shoulder.
Well, look who's a silver fox.
Will you look at that.
I'm sorry, you're okay?
You don't feel like your body's in decay
or death is inevitable?
My, my, somebody's being a gloomy goose.
Yeah, relax, gloomy goose.
Welcome, everybody, to another Gergage Christmas.
Now, sadly, one of our three beautiful angels,
Mellicent, couldn't be here tonight.
But our other two beauties, Miriam and Gladys,
are going to help Gail and me play a little tune.
Here we go, a caroling among the leaves so green.
Here we come, a wandering so fair to be seen.
Love and joy come to you.
And to you, glad Christmas too.
And God bless you and send you a happy new year.
